summary: Heavy Armour with AC 21 and no proficiency requirement. Reduces damage and grants flight.

fields.Training: Any wearer is considered proficient. Imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks.
fields.Prime Aegis of Fire: Fire resistance, immunity to Burning and 3 less damage from all sources.
fields.Infernal Retribution: When you succeed on a saving throw, the source of the spell receives Burning (Orthonic) for 3 turns.
fields.Fly: Bonus Action once per Long Rest. Grants Flight to yourself for 10 turns, with no concentration.
fields.Base value: 8000 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported armour interactions: Because it has no armour proficiency group, effects such as Bracers of Defence and Monk Unarmoured Movement can remain active. A hidden passive supplies +1 AC to wearers with the Defence fighting style, and can coexist with the normal +1 from another equipped armour piece.
fields.Burning (Orthonic): Deals 1d4 Fire damage per turn. Help, healing potions and becoming Wet do not remove it.
